title: Grayton Sunset on 30A's Grayton Beach | Ocean Reef Resorts
meta_description: This fabulous four-bedroom home near the historic village center of Grayton Beach has received impressive updates. It comfortably accommodates ten fortunate beachgoers and is aptly named since it has an outstanding position overlooking sandy white dunes with stunning views of spectacular sunsets
description_expanded: This fabulous four-bedroom home near the historic village center of Grayton Beach has received impressive updates. It comfortably accommodates ten fortunate beachgoers and is aptly named since it has an outstanding position overlooking sandy white dunes with stunning views of spectacular sunsets across the seascape. Grayton Sunset borders the Grayton Beach State Park , which was recently named as one of the most beautiful in America by Forbes Magazine. The crystalline white dunes adorned with sea oats span across the horizon. The glittering gulf is a jeweled backdrop and a short stroll away down a powdery dune trail. A comfortably furnished veranda off the Great Room provides the perfect place to view the sensational seascape, hear the soothing surf sounds and enjoy favorite tropical drinks. Another covered veranda on the first floor sits beside a large private swimming pool which measures 28' x 14'. Comfortable seating with a grill invites you to enjoy poolside drinks and dining. The tropically landscaped pool patio has lots of chairs to enjoy lounging in the sun. Stairs lead to a covered balcony beside a screened porch on the side, allowing you to enjoy the scenery. A Great Room on this level encompasses the open living, dining, and kitchen areas with a wall of windows looking out across the dunes toward the gulf. Another comfortably furnished veranda off this room beckons you to enjoy the heavenly sunsets during the cocktail hour. This home features an upscale, fashionable coastal style with oil paintings of seascapes, colorful tropical prints, and marine sculpture throughout.  A vaulted ceiling with thick beams soars above, and white shiplap interiors accentuate spaciousness. It features a crisp nautical look with two white safari slip-covered couches accented with decorative blue pillows that match a beautifully patterned rug. A large flatscreen TV mounted above a dormant fireplace mantle provides entertainment. The centered dining area has a rustic hardwood rectangular table and chairs for charmed dining. Another seating area beside a window with gorgeous gulf views includes two regal white armchairs and two tropically inspired straw woven chairs with cushioned seats. An open white bar nearby has matching saddle topped stools to serve delicious drinks and tasty appetizers easily. The Gourmet Kitchen inspires fun culinary delights with stainless steel appliances that include a wide French cabinet-styled refrigerator-freezer, a wine cooler, and a glass-topped oven range. The bright, cheerful Master Bedroom on this level has cottage-style furnishings, multiple windows, a king-sized bed with a cloth patterned headboard, and a large flatscreen TV. A full en suite bath features a walk-in shower, a mirrored wall beside a long white countertop with a vanity at each end, and a dressing table in the center. On this level, a lovely Guest Bedroom with beach-inspired décor has twin beds, a striped armchair, and access to a full hall bath. Two additional Guest Bedrooms with en suite baths are upstairs. One is handsomely appointed with a king-sized bed, comfortable furnishings, and a patterned Persian rug. The other stylish guest quarters have an upscale look with a queen-sized bed and adjacent bunk featuring two twin beds. Stairs lead to a furnished rooftop observation sundeck with sweeping vistas of the stellar seascape. This fantastic location in the center of Grayton Beach places you near great food, drinks, and live music at the famed Red Bar along with Chiringo . Many restaurants, beach bars, shopping venues, outdoor concerts, and lively festivals are minutes along Scenic 30A . First Floor:  Covered Parking. Second Floor:  Living Room with Balcony Access, Kitchen, Dining, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, Bedroom with Two Twin Beds and Shared Tub/Shower Combo, Laundry. Third Floor:  King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, Queen Bedroom with Twin Bunk and Walk-In Shower, Balcony Access. *add $50.00 per day to heat the pool (available October - April if needed) Sunday to Sunday reservations only during prime dates.
